payout_quote: You may earn a $400 reward if you open a new PNC Business Checking or PNC Business Checking Plus account. / You may earn a $1,000 reward if you open a new PNC Treasury Enterprise Plan (including Analysis Business Checking) account.
steps: Open a new PNC Business Checking or Business Checking Plus account (for $400) or a Treasury Enterprise Plan / Analysis Business Checking account (for $1,000) between July 1, 2026 and September 30, 2026.

For the $400 reward: maintain an average ledger balance of $2,000 in the new account for each of the first three statement cycles AND complete at least 10 total qualifying transactions (debit purchases, ACH, wire, Zelle, online banking/bill pay, remote/mobile deposits, checks) within the first three statement cycles.
For the $1,000 reward: maintain an average ledger balance of $30,000 or more for each of the first three statement cycles (master accounts only; linked beneficiary accounts do not count).
Keep the account open; the reward is credited as 'Credits NEW BUS BONUS' within 90 days after all conditions are met.
catches: Offer only for businesses with annual revenue less than $10 million.

New accounts only: any signer with signing authority on an existing PNC business checking account, who closed one within the past 90 days, or who was paid a promotional premium in the past 12 months is ineligible; one account eligible per signer group.
Only monthly-statement business checking accounts qualify (daily, weekly, or quarterly statement accounts are ineligible); established, converted, or repurposed accounts are ineligible.
Changing the checking product after opening can change or void eligibility and reward amount; you must remain in the opened product.
Reward credited up to 90 days after all conditions met; account must stay open to receive it.
Offers may be extended, modified or discontinued at any time; the reward may be reported on IRS Form 1099 as taxable income.
Business Checking Plus monthly service charges apply unless waived per the account disclosure (fee drag reduces net bonus if not waived).
biggest_catch: The $400 tier requires holding a $2,000 average ledger balance across the first three statement cycles PLUS 10 qualifying transactions in that window; the $1,000 tier needs a $30,000 average balance. Any signer with an existing PNC business checking account or a PNC bonus in the past 12 months is excluded; offer expires 9/30/2026.
eligibility: New PNC business checking customers only; business annual revenue under $10 million; no signer with authority on an existing PNC business checking account, none closed within 90 days, no promotional premium paid in past 12 months.
timing: Open between 7/1/2026 and 9/30/2026; requirements measured over the first three statement cycles; reward credited within 90 days after all conditions are met.
